Request Access to the GTCI Dataset
The GTCI dataset is available for legitimate academic and policy-making research. Complete the form below — all requests are reviewed by the GTCI team.
Data Access Policy The GTCI dataset may be made available for legitimate academic and policy-making research. Raw indicator values are not shared. All users must acknowledge the GTCI source in any resulting papers or publications.
